시편 28:1.content: A Psalm of David. Unto thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

시편 28:2.content: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

시편 28:3.content: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

시편 28:4.content: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

시편 28:5.content: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

시편 28:6.content: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

시편 28:7.content: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

시편 28:8.content: The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

시편 28:9.content: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
